meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文榜单，提炼市场热点与热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者或编辑,想了解平台榜单背后的热门题材趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Scan web novel rankings to identify hot genres and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author or editor wanting to understand market trends from ranking data.

howto.what: Claude 转为长篇网文市场分析师：采集起点、番茄、晋江等平台榜单数据并清洗，产出扫榜报告（题材热度排行、新题材信号、关键数据洞察）和一份选题决策.md。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜，或问「长篇什么火」这类问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜，看现在什么题材火
say.note: 先确认平台和方向，再取数分析

say.text: 分析番茄男频阅读榜，给我 3 个能写的选题
say.note: 会先采集数据再出选题决策

say.text: 对比起点和晋江榜单，看两个平台题材差异
say.note: 按各自核心指标做平台对比

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a web-novel market analyst: it scrapes and cleans ranking data from Qidian, Fanqie, Jinjiang and more, then writes a scan report (genre heat, new-genre signals, data insights) plus a topic-decision file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /story-long-scan or /长篇扫榜, or ask things like "what's hot in long web novels" or about Qidian rankings.

say_en.text: Scan the Qidian monthly-ticket ranking and tell me what genres are hot
say_en.note: Confirms platform and direction first, then collects data

say_en.text: Analyze the Fanqie male-channel reading ranking and give me 3 writable topics
say_en.note: Collects data before producing topic decisions

say_en.text: Compare Qidian and Jinjiang rankings to show genre differences
say_en.note: Uses each platform's core metrics for comparison
